description: This file contains mathematical functions for effects processing, including logarithmic, exponential, and square root calculations, used in media effects within the Android project.

methods.name: Effects_log2
methods.description: Calculates the base-2 logarithm of an unsigned 32-bit integer using a lookup table and bit operations.

methods.name: Effects_exp2
methods.description: Computes 2 raised to the power of a fixed-point integer, using a lookup table for efficiency.

methods.name: Effects_MillibelsToLinear16
methods.description: Converts a millibel gain value to a 16-bit linear scale using exponential approximation.

methods.name: Effects_Linear16ToMillibels
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit linear gain value to millibels using logarithmic approximation.

methods.name: Effects_Sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the integer square root of a 32-bit integer using a bit-shifting algorithm.
